## What

A JIT CUDA MoE router, `moe_route_warp`: one warp per token, each lane holds E/32 experts as order-preserving u32 keys, sorts them once (compile-time Batcher network in the new `sgl_kernel/algorithm.cuh`), and every top-k round reduces only the 32 lane heads (`redux` max, then min lane for the lowest-id tie-break). The launcher picks 1 warp per CTA while all tokens fit in one wave and 4 warps per CTA beyond that.

Covered (static config, 128..512 experts, multiple of 32): sigmoid / sqrtsoftplus with correction bias (grouped `noaux_tc` or ungrouped) and softmax, fp32 / bf16 logits, fused shared-expert slots, renorm epsilon, `num_token_non_padded`, packed FlashInfer ids. `moe_fused_gate` and `biased_grouped_topk_gpu` dispatch to it whenever the config is covered; everything else (fewer than 128 experts, Kimi-K3's 896, softcap, fp16 logits) keeps the Triton router.

Also:
- DeepSeek-V4.1 VL per-token bias (`input_ids` / `bias_alt`) as a compile-time mode; the token id is loaded before the PDL wait.
- MuseSpark routing moves to the same kernel (compile-time mode); `muse_spark/routing.cuh` is removed.
- Removed kernels whose paths now go through `moe_fused_gate`: the JIT `topk_softmax` (unused on CUDA), the LoRA `kimi_k2_moe_fused_gate` and `topk_softmax_pack` (and the two LoRA env flags of the former).
- NaN logits rank last (as DeepGEMM's mega-gate).

## Performance

B200, CUDA graph, median; main path = flashinfer `fused_topk_deepseek` (DeepSeek-V3) or the Triton router (others). Router alone, us:

| config | T=1 | T=1024 | T=16384 |
|---|---|---|---|
| DeepSeek-V3 (256, 8 groups / 4, top-8) | 1.88 -> 1.43 | 3.07 -> 1.97 | 24.6 -> 12.3 |
| Kimi-K2 (384, top-8) | 2.42 -> 1.60 | 4.22 -> 2.33 | 39.7 -> 13.1 |
| GLM-4.5 (160, top-8) | 1.80 -> 1.43 | 2.91 -> 1.80 | 23.4 -> 9.4 |
| Qwen3-MoE (128, top-8, softmax) | 2.38 -> 1.23 | 2.99 -> 1.60 | 13.9 -> 8.2 |
| Qwen3.5 (512, top-10, softmax) | 3.40 -> 1.68 | 5.82 -> 2.33 | 63.1 -> 15.6 |
| DeepSeek-V4.1 (384, top-6, sqrtsoftplus) | 2.50 -> 1.64 | 3.93 -> 2.91 | 35.2 -> 17.2 |
| DeepSeek-V4.1 VL (per-token bias) | 2.58 -> 1.99 | 4.10 -> 2.85 | 35.6 -> 17.6 |
| MuseSpark (256, top-8; old JIT kernel) | 1.64 -> 1.27 | 2.70 -> 1.97 | 16.8 -> 10.7 |

Behind the gate GEMM with PDL (decode), the router costs 0.5-2 us less per MoE layer. H200 gains are larger (e.g. Kimi-K2 T=16384 45.6 -> 15.8 us).

## Validation

- Router vs an fp64 reference (sigmoid / softmax / sqrtsoftplus, grouped and ungrouped, renorm, scaling, fused shared slots, padding, packed ids, per-token bias): same expert set up to near ties, descending ranking order, weights within fp32 rounding; exact ties go to the lowest expert id. NaN / inf handling is implementation-defined and not pinned by tests.
- `test_moe_route_warp`, `test_muse_spark_routing`, `test_moe_fused_gate`, `test_jit_grouped_topk`, `test_fused_topk_deepseek`, `test_marlin_packed_topk_unpack` and the MoE dispatch / routing unit tests pass on B200 and H200.
- End-to-end on 1x H200, this PR vs its parent on main (sgl-eval gsm8k, full 1319, seeds 1 / 2; decode ITL from `one_batch_server`, input 512 / output 256):

| model | gsm8k main | gsm8k PR | ITL bs1 / bs8 / bs32 (ms), main -> PR |
|---|---|---|---|
| Ling-mini-2.0 (256 experts, grouped sigmoid) | 89.92 / 90.67 | 90.22 / 91.21 | 1.85 / 2.65 / 3.75 -> 1.80 / 2.38 / 3.66 |
| Qwen3-30B-A3B (`--moe-runner-backend triton`, softmax) | 94.92 / 94.92 | 94.92 / 94.69 | 3.68 / 7.55 / 11.50 -> 3.65 / 7.15 / 11.08 |

  Sampling: temperature 0.7, top_p 0.8, max 4096 tokens (Qwen3 non-thinking). Gaps are within the ~1 pp standard error.

+"""One-warp-per-token CUDA MoE router (sigmoid / sqrtsoftplus + bias, softmax).
+
+Softmax with a correction bias ranks and weighs ``softmax(logits + bias)``, as
+the Triton router in ``moe_fused_gate``.
+
+Same contract as the router in ``moe_fused_gate`` for the inputs ``covered``
+accepts: fp32 weights and int32 ids in descending ranking order, lowest expert
+id wins ties, rows past ``num_token_non_padded`` get zero weights and id -1,
+fused shared-expert slots follow the routed ones. NaN logits rank last. Grouped
+routing scores a group by the sum of its two largest biased values, a duplicated
+maximum counted twice (DeepSeek reference and flashinfer ``fused_topk_deepseek``).
+"""
+
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import enum
+import functools
+from typing import TYPE_CHECKING, Optional, Tuple
+
+import torch
+
+from sglang.kernels.jit.utils import (
+    cache_once,
+    is_arch_support_pdl,
+    load_jit,
+    make_cpp_args,
+)
+
+if TYPE_CHECKING:
+    from tvm_ffi.module import Module
+
+
+class Scoring(str, enum.Enum):
+    """Router scoring; the value is the ``scoring_func`` string srt passes."""
+
+    SIGMOID = "sigmoid"
+    SOFTMAX = "softmax"
+    SQRTSOFTPLUS = "sqrtsoftplus"
+
+    @property
+    def cpp_name(self) -> str:
+        return self.name
+
+
+_SCORING_FUNCS = frozenset(s.value for s in Scoring)
+
+
+@cache_once
+def _jit_route_warp_module(
+    num_experts: int,
+    topk: int,
+    num_groups: int,
+    topk_groups: int,
+    scoring_func: str,
+    dtype: torch.dtype,
+    bias_dtype: torch.dtype,
+    has_bias: bool,
+    muse_spark: bool,
+    token_bias: bool,
+) -> Module:
+    args = make_cpp_args(
+        num_experts,
+        topk,
+        num_groups,
+        topk_groups,
+        Scoring(scoring_func).cpp_name,
+        dtype,
+        bias_dtype,
+        has_bias,
+        is_arch_support_pdl(),
+        muse_spark,
+        token_bias,
+    )
+    return load_jit(
+        "moe_route_warp",
+        *args,
+        cuda_files=["moe/route_warp.cuh"],
+        cuda_wrappers=[("run", f"moe::route_warp::RouteWarpKernel<{args}>::run")],
+    )
+
+
+@functools.cache
+def _device_ok(device_index: Optional[int]) -> bool:
+    # redux.sync needs SM80+; the kernel is CUDA-only.
+    return (
+        torch.version.hip is None
+        and torch.cuda.get_device_capability(device_index)[0] >= 8
+    )
+
+
+@functools.cache
+def covered(
+    scores_dtype: torch.dtype,
+    num_experts: int,
+    topk: int,
+    scoring_func: str,
+    num_fused_shared_experts: int = 0,
+    num_expert_group: int = 1,
+    topk_group: int = 1,
+    device_index: Optional[int] = None,
+) -> bool:
+    """Whether :func:`moe_route_warp` serves this router config. Static facts
+    only; the launcher rejects misaligned or non-row-major logits."""
+    if not _device_ok(device_index) or scoring_func not in _SCORING_FUNCS:
+        return False
+    if scores_dtype not in (torch.float32, torch.bfloat16):
+        return False
+    # Moonlight (64 experts) bs1 decode on H200 lost 20-30 us per step: the earlier
+    # expert GEMM shares SMs with the shared-expert stream. Arbitrary cutoff.
+    if num_experts % 32 or not 128 <= num_experts <= 512:
+        return False
+    k_routed = topk - num_fused_shared_experts
+    if k_routed < 1 or topk > 32:
+        return False
+    if num_expert_group > 1:
+        experts_per_group = num_experts // num_expert_group
+        if scoring_func == Scoring.SOFTMAX or 32 % num_expert_group:
+            return False
+        if experts_per_group != (32 // num_expert_group) * (num_experts // 32):
+            return False
+        if topk_group * experts_per_group < k_routed:
+            return False
+    return True
+
+
+def bias_layout_ok(*biases: Optional[torch.Tensor]) -> bool:
+    """Whether every given bias has the layout the kernel loads: contiguous and
+    16-byte aligned (the widest bias vector). Other views stay on Triton."""
+    return all(
+        b is None or (b.is_contiguous() and b.data_ptr() % 16 == 0) for b in biases
+    )
+
+
+def moe_route_warp(
+    scores: torch.Tensor,
+    bias: Optional[torch.Tensor],
+    topk: int,
+    scoring_func: str = "sigmoid",
+    num_fused_shared_experts: int = 0,
+    renormalize: bool = True,
+    routed_scaling_factor: Optional[float] = 1.0,
+    apply_routed_scaling_factor_on_output: bool = False,
+    num_expert_group: int = 1,
+    topk_group: int = 1,
+    num_token_non_padded: Optional[torch.Tensor] = None,
+    renormalize_epsilon: float = 0.0,
+    packed_out: Optional[torch.Tensor] = None,
+    input_ids: Optional[torch.Tensor] = None,
+    bias_alt: Optional[torch.Tensor] = None,
+    bias_alt_token_id: Optional[int] = None,
+) -> Tuple[torch.Tensor, torch.Tensor]:
+    """Returns (weights [T, topk] fp32, ids [T, topk] int32); ``topk`` counts the
+    fused shared-expert slots. ``bias`` is optional for softmax, which then
+    ranks and weighs ``logits + bias``. ``num_token_non_padded`` is an int32
+    device scalar. ``packed_out`` ([T, topk] int32) also receives ``id << 16 |
+    bf16_bits(weight)``. Rows whose ``input_ids`` equal ``bias_alt_token_id``
+    rank with ``bias_alt`` instead of ``bias``. Caller must have checked
+    :func:`covered` and :func:`bias_layout_ok`."""
+    num_tokens, num_experts = scores.shape
+    if routed_scaling_factor is None:
+        routed_scaling_factor = 1.0
+    grouped = num_expert_group > 1
+    module = _jit_route_warp_module(
+        num_experts,
+        topk - num_fused_shared_experts,
+        num_expert_group if grouped else 1,
+        topk_group if grouped else 1,
+        scoring_func,
+        scores.dtype,
+        torch.float32 if bias is None else bias.dtype,
+        has_bias=bias is not None,
+        muse_spark=False,
+        token_bias=input_ids is not None,
+    )
+    out_w = torch.empty((num_tokens, topk), dtype=torch.float32, device=scores.device)
+    out_i = torch.empty((num_tokens, topk), dtype=torch.int32, device=scores.device)
+    module.run(
+        scores,
+        bias,
+        out_w,
+        out_i,
+        packed_out,
+        num_token_non_padded,
+        num_fused_shared_experts,

+"""The warp router must select the same experts as an fp64 reference (up to near
+ties) with weights within fp32 rounding, keep its own contracts (lowest id wins
+exact ties, padding, packed ids, fused shared slots), and srt must dispatch to it."""
+
+from __future__ import annotations

+import functools
+import sys
+from unittest.mock import patch
+
+import pytest
+import torch
+
+from sglang.kernels.jit.utils import parallel_compile
+from sglang.kernels.ops.moe import moe_route_warp as route_warp_module
+from sglang.kernels.ops.moe.moe_fused_gate import moe_fused_gate
+from sglang.kernels.ops.moe.moe_route_warp import covered, moe_route_warp
+from sglang.test.ci.ci_register import register_cuda_ci
+
+register_cuda_ci(est_time=20, stage="base-b-kernel-unit", runner_config="1-gpu-large")
+
+DEVICE = "cuda"
+
+# name -> (experts, topk, scoring, groups, topk_groups, logits dtype)
+CONFIGS = {
+    "deepseek_v3": (256, 8, "sigmoid", 8, 4, torch.float32),
+    "kimi_k2": (384, 8, "sigmoid", 1, 1, torch.float32),
+    "glm4_5": (160, 8, "sigmoid", 1, 1, torch.float32),
+    "glm5": (256, 8, "sigmoid", 1, 1, torch.float32),
+    "qwen3_moe": (128, 8, "softmax", 1, 1, torch.bfloat16),
+    "qwen3_5_moe": (512, 10, "softmax", 1, 1, torch.bfloat16),
+    "gpt_oss": (128, 4, "softmax", 1, 1, torch.bfloat16),
+    "deepseek_v4": (384, 6, "sqrtsoftplus", 1, 1, torch.float32),
+}
+
+
+@pytest.fixture(scope="module", autouse=True)
+def _prebuild() -> None:
+    # (experts, routed topk, groups, topk_groups, scoring, logits, bias dtype, has_bias, token_bias)
+    f32, bf16 = torch.float32, torch.bfloat16
+    variants = set()
+    for experts, topk, scoring, groups, topk_groups, dtype in CONFIGS.values():
+        has_bias = scoring != "softmax"
+        variants.add(
+            (experts, topk, groups, topk_groups, scoring, dtype, f32, has_bias, False)
+        )
+        variants.add(
+            (experts, topk, groups, topk_groups, scoring, dtype, f32, True, False)
+        )
+    variants |= {
+        (384, 6, 1, 1, "sqrtsoftplus", f32, bf16, True, False),
+        (384, 8, 1, 1, "sigmoid", f32, bf16, True, False),
+        (384, 8, 1, 1, "sigmoid", f32, torch.float16, True, False),
+        (384, 6, 1, 1, "sqrtsoftplus", f32, f32, True, True),
+        (128, 8, 1, 1, "softmax", bf16, bf16, True, False),
+        (512, 10, 1, 1, "softmax", bf16, bf16, True, False),
+        (128, 4, 1, 1, "softmax", bf16, bf16, True, False),
+        (128, 8, 1, 1, "softmax", bf16, f32, True, True),
+    }
+    parallel_compile(
+        functools.partial(
+            route_warp_module._jit_route_warp_module,
+            *v[:8],
+            muse_spark=False,
+            token_bias=v[8],
+        )
+        for v in sorted(variants, key=str)
+    )
+
+
+def _inputs(config: str, num_tokens: int, seed: int = 0):
+    num_experts, _, scoring, _, _, dtype = CONFIGS[config]
+    g = torch.Generator(device=DEVICE).manual_seed(seed)
+    scores = torch.randn(num_tokens, num_experts, device=DEVICE, generator=g) * 2
+    bias = None
+    if scoring != "softmax":
+        bias = torch.randn(num_experts, device=DEVICE, generator=g) * 0.1
+    return scores.to(dtype), bias
+
+
+def _kwargs(config: str, **overrides):
+    _, topk, scoring, groups, topk_groups, _ = CONFIGS[config]
+    kwargs = dict(
+        topk=topk,
+        scoring_func=scoring,
+        renormalize=True,
+        routed_scaling_factor=2.5,
+        num_expert_group=groups,
+        topk_group=topk_groups,
+    )
+    kwargs.update(overrides)
+    return kwargs
+
+
+def _reference(
+    scores,
+    bias,
+    *,
+    topk,
+    scoring_func,
+    renormalize=True,
+    routed_scaling_factor=1.0,
+    apply_routed_scaling_factor_on_output=False,
+    num_expert_group=1,
+    topk_group=1,
+    num_fused_shared_experts=0,
+    renormalize_epsilon=0.0,
+):
+    """fp64 routing: (weights, ids, near_tie rows, ranking scores); ties go to the lowest id."""
+    x = scores.double()
+    if scoring_func == "softmax":
+        ranking = x if bias is None else x + bias.double()
+        act = ranking.softmax(-1)
+    else:
+        if scoring_func == "sigmoid":
+            act = x.sigmoid()
+        else:
+            act = (x.clamp(min=0) + torch.log1p(torch.exp(-x.abs()))).sqrt()
+        ranking = act + bias.double()
+    num_tokens, num_experts = x.shape
+    if num_expert_group > 1:
+        groups = ranking.view(num_tokens, num_expert_group, -1)
+        keep = torch.zeros(num_tokens, num_expert_group, device=x.device)
+        keep.scatter_(
+            1, groups.topk(2, -1).values.sum(-1).topk(topk_group, -1).indices, 1
+        )
+        keep = keep.repeat_interleave(num_experts // num_expert_group, dim=1)
+        ranking = ranking.masked_fill(keep == 0, float("-inf"))
+    k = topk - num_fused_shared_experts
+    order = torch.sort(ranking, dim=-1, descending=True, stable=True)
+    ids = order.indices[:, :k]
+    gap = (order.values[:, k - 1] - order.values[:, k]).abs()
+    near_tie = gap <= 1e-6 * order.values[:, k - 1].abs().clamp(min=1)
+    weights = act.gather(1, ids)
+    if renormalize:
+        total = weights.sum(-1, keepdim=True)
+        if renormalize_epsilon > 0:
+            weights = weights / (total + renormalize_epsilon)
+        else:
+            # Zero-sum guard of the routers: an all-zero row stays zero.
+            weights = weights / torch.where(total > 0, total, torch.ones_like(total))
+    if apply_routed_scaling_factor_on_output:
+        weights = weights * routed_scaling_factor
+    if num_fused_shared_experts:
+        shared = (
+            1.0
+            if apply_routed_scaling_factor_on_output
+            else 1.0 / routed_scaling_factor
+        )
+        weights = torch.cat(
+            [weights, weights.new_full((num_tokens, num_fused_shared_experts), shared)],
+            1,
+        )
+        extra = torch.arange(num_fused_shared_experts, device=x.device) + num_experts
+        ids = torch.cat([ids, extra.expand(num_tokens, -1)], 1)
+    return weights, ids, near_tie, ranking
+
+
+def _assert_matches(w, i, ref, k_routed):
+    rw, ri, near_tie, ranking = ref
+    i = i.long()
+    same = (i[:, :k_routed].sort(-1).values == ri[:, :k_routed].sort(-1).values).all(-1)
+    assert bool((same | near_tie).all())
+    assert torch.equal(i[:, k_routed:], ri[:, k_routed:])
+    # Descending ranking order.
+    ranked = ranking.gather(1, i[:, :k_routed])
+    assert bool((ranked[:, :-1] >= ranked[:, 1:] - 1e-6).all())
+    got = w.double().gather(1, i.argsort(-1))
+    want = rw.gather(1, ri.argsort(-1))
+    torch.testing.assert_close(got[same], want[same], rtol=1e-5, atol=1e-6)
+
+
+def _check(scores, bias, **kwargs):
+    w, i = moe_route_warp(scores, bias, **kwargs)
+    k_routed = kwargs["topk"] - kwargs.get("num_fused_shared_experts", 0)
+    _assert_matches(w, i, _reference(scores, bias, **kwargs), k_routed)
+

+@pytest.mark.parametrize("config", list(CONFIGS))
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("num_tokens", [1, 3, 64, 600, 5000])
+def test_matches_reference(config: str, num_tokens: int) -> None:
+    scores, bias = _inputs(config, num_tokens, seed=num_tokens)
+    kwargs = _kwargs(config)
+    assert covered(
+        scores.dtype,
+        scores.shape[1],
+        kwargs["topk"],
+        kwargs["scoring_func"],
+        0,
+        kwargs["num_expert_group"],
+        kwargs["topk_group"],
+    )
+    _check(scores, bias, **kwargs)

+@pytest.mark.parametrize(
+    "config", ["deepseek_v3", "kimi_k2", "qwen3_moe", "deepseek_v4"]

Fixed in efa4fedfd5: `sqrtsoftplus` now evaluates `w = exp(-|x|/2)` and returns `w * sqrt(log1p(z)/z)` with `z = w^2` for `x <= 0`, so the result stays normal down to x = -174 (where exp(x/2) itself becomes subnormal) instead of flushing below about -87. Regression tests: `test_sqrtsoftplus_uniform_tail` (384 experts, top-6, all logits -88 -> ids 0..5, weights 1/6) and `test_sqrtsoftplus_negative_tail` (shifts -50/-88/-104/-120/-170, zero and random bias, exact ids and weights vs the fp64 reference) in test/registered/kernels/ops/moe/test_moe_route_warp.py.

> (auto generated by Claude)

Instead of falling back, the kernel now supports it (efa4fedfd5): with a bias, softmax ranks and weighs `softmax(logits + bias)`, the same as the Triton router, and the bias is no longer dropped (a `kBias` template flag, so unbiased softmax compiles as before). Token bias also works with softmax now. Grouped softmax is still not covered and stays on Triton. Tests in test/registered/kernels/ops/moe/test_moe_route_warp.py: `test_softmax_bias` (128/512/128-expert configs, fp32/bf16 bias, renormalize on/off, scaling, epsilon, shared slots; vs the fp64 reference and the Triton router, and it checks that the bias changes the selection), `test_softmax_bias_dispatch`, `test_softmax_token_bias`, `test_softmax_bias_grouped_falls_back`.

> (auto generated by Claude)

Fixed in 424a5e5149: the logit is no longer clamped to -174. `sqrtsoftplus` returns exactly 0 once `exp(x/2)` underflows (about x < -176, and for -inf), branch-free: when 2^n underflows, the exponent add wraps into the sign bit and an `fmaxf` maps the result to 0. An all-underflowed row then gives zero weights through the existing zero-sum guard (or sum + eps when `renormalize_epsilon > 0`), the same as the reference. New test `test_sqrtsoftplus_underflow` (eps 0 and 1e-20) covers all -1000 rows, a single live expert among -1000s, rows that are partly underflowed, and -inf logits. Ids and weights are compared with the fp64 reference, which now applies the routers' zero-sum guard.

> (auto generated by Claude)

Fixed in 424a5e5149: a new `moe_route_warp.bias_layout_ok(bias, bias_alt)` (contiguous and 16-byte aligned) gates the dispatch in `moe_fused_gate` and in the grouped path of `biased_grouped_topk_gpu`, so strided or offset bias views stay on Triton. New test `test_strided_bias_falls_back` (sigmoid and softmax configs, `torch.randn(2E)[::2]` and a 4-byte-offset slice) is compared with the reference.
